# Overview {-}

**Author:** Sean Westwood

Part of the [demystR](https://demystr.github.io) series.

What the book is about, and the black box it opens.

Every idea in this book is shown three ways:

- **the equation**: the idea written down formally, in mathematical notation;
- **the picture**: a figure that shows what the equation does;
- **the code**: the same thing written in R, so you can use it on data.

<div class="summary-box">
If you can point at a term in an equation, see what it does in a figure, and find the
line of code that computes it, you understand that part of the method.
</div>
